# `.github/` — Repository automation

Future home of GitHub collaboration files: issue templates, workflows, and community health files.

## Current contents

| File                          | Purpose                                  |
| ----------------------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| `pull_request_template.md`    | Checklist for focused, honest pull requests |

## Rules

- Automation is added only when it serves reviewers — no decorative CI.
- A status badge appears in the README only after its workflow actually runs green.
